subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: This 7-day tour flies with China Southern Airlines from Manila via Guangzhou to Changsha. You visit Furong Town, the ancient town that hangs on a waterfall, then spend three nights in Zhangjiajie, where the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park) with Hallelujah Mountain is the highlight. You stay in 5-star hotels and travel by private coach with an English-speaking guide. The programme includes several shop stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 19–25 2026 to Mar 26–Apr 1 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient town built against a waterfall in Hunan; the tour includes a cruise and battery cart.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum of pictures made from Zhangjiajie's coloured sandstone.
placeDesc.72-Floor Stilts Tower: A tall building in Zhangjiajie raised on stilts, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Avatar Scenic Area (Zhangjiajie National: Quartz-sandstone pillar peaks that inspired the Avatar film, reached by Bailong Elevator or Tianzishan cable car.
placeDesc.No. 1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge spanning a gap in the Zhangjiajie sandstone peaks.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: A floating-mountain landmark in the park that inspired the film's Hallelujah Mountains.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic stream path winding through forest below towering rock pillars.
placeDesc.Water Around Four Gates: A scenic spot of mountain streams and rock walls in Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon C Line Glass Bridge: A glass-bottomed bridge over the Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon, with a VR experience included.
placeDesc.Huangxin Road Walkway Street: A pedestrian shopping street in Changsha for free shopping and snacks.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain (optional): A mountain near Zhangjiajie with a cable car, glass skywalk and the Tianmen Cave.
placeDesc.Huanglong Cave (optional): A large limestone cave near Zhangjiajie, visited with an underground boat cruise.
